name: The Cove Atlantis
insider_take: The Cove Atlantis is Nassau's most exclusive adults-only sanctuary, where luxury meets the legendary Atlantis resort experience in an intimate, sophisticated setting.
whats_special: This ultra-luxe all-suite resort sits on Paradise Island's most pristine stretch of Cove Beach, offering exclusive access to all Atlantis amenities including the world's largest open-air marine habitat and Aquaventure waterpark. The property features stunning ocean-view suites with marble bathrooms, plus adults-only Cove Pool with private cabanas and poolside gaming.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors for breathtaking views of Nassau Harbor, and make dinner reservations at Nobu as soon as you arrive - it's consistently booked solid.
dont_miss: Swimming with dolphins at Dolphin Cay, exploring the lost city of Atlantis in the Ruins Lagoon, and experiencing the thrilling Leap of Faith waterslide that plunges through a shark-filled lagoon. The nearby Nassau Straw Market offers authentic Bahamian crafts just a short water taxi ride away.
pros: Adults-only sophisticated atmosphere with tranquil environment
Access to all Atlantis Resort amenities including water parks and aquarium
Ultra-luxury accommodations with premium oceanview suites
Exclusive Cove Pool with private poolside service and cabanas
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
